why: Nearest-rank read one place too high: p50 of 1..100 becomes 51. Every percentile the report quotes would be a frame slower than the one the rank names, which on a phone run moves a budget line without anyone seeing why.
killedBy: summarizeFrames: nearest-rank percentiles and long-frame counts takes percentiles by nearest rank from unsorted input: 1..100 gives p50 50, p95 95, p99 99
buildBenchReport summarizes intervals as frames and callback time as work, never the other way round
